en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian square with mountains in the background. Prominently visible are a tall medieval clock tower with crenellations at the top, a large baroque fountain in the center of the square, arcaded buildings and palazzi surrounding the piazza, and a church with a domed roof and ornate façade. The caption at the top left reads in red script: "Trento - Piazza del Duomo".
